purpose: Teach: 練馬/ニンテンドー/ローリング/ヤフオク/ホモ/シャロン/スタミナ/チャンピオンズ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが練馬区のお仕事先にお出かけよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has to go to work in Nerima today.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. A gentle reminder phrased as simple news. Slight lift at the end—inviting his attention without demand. Patient rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとニンテンドーで遊んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I played Nintendo with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick attack on the opening word. Eager to share. Voice bounces slightly—he's already picturing it. Clean, unfiltered joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがローリング・ストーンズのコンサート観たいって
lines.en: Sho, your dad mentioned he'd like to see a Rolling Stones concert.
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational tone. Slightly longer pause before the verb—she's considering this fact as she shares it. Warm observational quality, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとヤフオクで時計買ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I bought a watch on Yahoo Auctions!
lines.style: Rapid, bubbling enthusiasm. Sharp onset on 'bought.' Words tumble slightly into each other. Voice rises on the object—the watch is the prize. Genuine six-year-old pride.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがホモ・サピエンスの進化のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told us such an interesting story about human evolution.
lines.style: Warm with a touch of quiet amusement. Measured cadence—she's still half in that conversation herself. Slight emphasis on 'interesting,' genuine appreciation for his effort to share knowledge.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとシャロン元首相のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched the Champions League final!
lines.style: Quick, energetic onset. Rushing slightly with excitement—he can barely contain it. Voice peaks on 'final.' Small pause before that word, letting anticipation build. Pure breathless joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「スタミナをつけろ」って仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told you to build up your stamina.
lines.style: Light, practical tone. Small knowing warmth—she's relaying fatherly advice with gentle humor. Even pacing. Slight uptick on 'stamina,' as if she's quoting him gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとチャンピオンズリーグ決勝観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched the Champions League final together!
lines.style: Warm, final-statement quality. Gentle enthusiasm—not manic, but satisfied and whole. Lingers slightly on 'together.' The full story is told. Soft, contented close.
